name: AI Tools Guide

sources.title: Submit page (search-indexed snapshot) — 4-field form: tool name, website URL, category, 'why should it be listed'; direct fetch returned HTTP 503
Third-party submission guide — no signup/captcha; category defaults to 'Writing' (change it); published blurb traces to the site's meta description; outbound link is a noindex/nofollow redirect
Batch-provided submission URL — a feedback form, not the listing route; also 503 on direct fetch

requirements: AI tool with a working website
No account, no captcha — a single 4-field form at /submit
Submissions are reviewed weekly; links are validated before inclusion
preparation: Fix your homepage meta description first — the published listing blurb is reproduced from it almost verbatim
Correct category (the picker defaults to 'Writing' — the top failure mode)
A short 'why should it be listed' note read by a human reviewer; makers should include use cases and pricing details
workflow: Open https://aitoolsguide.com/submit (note: the site returned HTTP 503 to automated fetches at research time — verify it is up in a browser)
Fill tool name, website URL, pick the correct category, and write the why-list note
Wait for the weekly review cycle; the published page reproduces your meta description as the blurb
watchFor: Batch submission URL /contact is a feedback form — the real route is /submit
Category picker defaults to 'Writing' — failing to change it mislists the tool
Outbound links are redirects marked noindex/nofollow per a third-party analysis — SEO value is minimal; value is listing presence
Site health is questionable — all pages returned 503 during research; confirm it is accepting submissions before investing effort
countsAsLive: The tool appears in an aitoolsguide.com category listing with its name, description and outbound link
unknowns: Whether the site is currently operational (503s on every route fetched)
Whether makers can later edit or claim their listing
